_comment: Live tuning knobs for the screener. Human explanation lives in scoring.md. One 'session' = one daily run (a trading day); weekends produce no session, so ages are counted in sessions, not calendar days.
_comment_v2: Price/volume (Yahoo .JK) + news + signal thresholds. Prices are the last COMPLETED session (morning run = yesterday's close).
_comment_v3: Sectors API foreign flow. DEPRECATED by the 'brokers' block below — fetch_brokers.py derives net foreign flow exactly from per-broker data at 1 credit/ticker. Kept for one release as a fallback. tier scales spend: lean ~32, standard ~50, deep ~91.
_comment_v4: Broker-cohort flow (v3). One /broker-summary/ call per ticker (1 credit) returns every broker's buy/sell/net for history_days, from which we derive the group split, net foreign flow, accumulation runs and ticket sizes. Groups are behavioural and live in reference/brokers.csv. Ratios are RELATIVE to each stock's own median value-per-trade, because a fixed rupiah threshold misclassifies across price levels.
_comment_v5: Prices. Sectors /daily/ is primary for the top price_sectors_n crowded tickers (1 credit each, 90-day window covers d1/d5/RVOL); everything else, and any Sectors failure, falls back to Yahoo .JK for free.
